action_summary: Verified-prior path for the Perfect Algorithm: every stored prior row is now re-executed on the fresh instance before it is trusted. Only root-row transitions that hold survive into the scan seed; everything else is discarded and re-derived. The loop previously seeded a fresh instance's scan with another instance's entire learned model as if it were its own transitions, which is exactly the wrong kind of instant knowledge. Also added a fresh-family receipt demonstrating that a same-family instance with different walls honestly re-verifies, re-derives and reaches the goal, while the stale plan rule is never served.
